The competition is part of [San Marino Game Convention](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanMarinoNationals2024#35366-san-marino-game-convention).

La competizione è parte di [San Marino Game Convention](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanMarinoNationals2024#35366-san-marino-game-convention).
**Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.**
Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanMarinoNationals2024#35363-registration-registrazione-faq).

items.information:
* You need to pay in advance the registration fee in order to complete your registration. No registrations will be accepted without payouts.
*  Remember to check you email address for confirmation message which will be likely sent 2-3 weeks before the competition.
* **You can have a full refund if you delete your registration by April 22nd**, otherwise no refunds will be given.
